scripts.build: npm run build -w @ng-email/render && npm run build -w @ng-email/components && npm run build -w @ng-email/cli && npm run build -w @ng-email/blocks
scripts.test: npm run build && node tools/run-tests.mjs packages/render packages/components && node --test --test-reporter=spec "packages/blocks/test/*.test.mjs" "packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs" && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: ngc -p packages/render/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && ngc -p packages/components/tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && ngc -p packages/blocks/tsconfig.json
